verification.evidence: multi-select: no errors; only prop warnings for intentional additions (open, onOpenChange).

gaps: Phase 1 still-state: chips and the overflow count render at their resting end-state with no slot-spring travel; the menu mounts when open with no enter/exit travel; the check renders fully drawn. Phase 2 wires the chip slot springs, overflow count roll, check path draw, and menu spring.

ARC source is custom-built (no Radix primitives), so there were no ARC primitive parts to map 1:1. bits-ui Combobox (Root type=multiple, Trigger, ContentStatic, Item) hosts open/multi-selection, menu semantics, trigger keyboard, outside-dismiss, and data-state; chips, overflow math, and the clear button follow ARC.

CSS kept verbatim, so the highlight hook stays data-active: it is driven by ARC activeIndex state synced from bits Item onHighlight/onUnhighlight, and reset when the menu closes. bits-ui additionally sets data-highlighted, which is unstyled.

Option host is a bits Item (div with role=option) rather than the ARC button element; selection state comes from the Item children snippet ({ selected }) and disabled options are skipped by bits-ui with aria-disabled.

Trigger keyboard (Enter/Space toggle, arrows navigate, Escape closes) is owned by bits-ui, replacing the ARC custom onKeyDown; the trigger carries ARC aria-labelledby labelling and the screen-reader value text.

Combobox Input/Portal/Viewport/ScrollButtons parts not applicable: the trigger owns the anchor, content renders statically in place (ARC CSS absolute positioning), and the list scrolls natively. No forceMount: the menu mounts on open, matching ARC AnimatePresence mount/unmount; no {#if} is written around any bits presence part.
React-only className dropped in favour of Svelte class. Added bindable open/onOpenChange for control through the bits-ui host (check-port prop warnings, intentional).
lucide-react imports mapped to @lucide/svelte/icons/<kebab> (chevron-down, x) with ARC size preserved; the option check is inline SVG per ARC (static end-state, no path draw).
